questions.question: What is a fiscal year?

options.text: A year that represents the financial reporting period for the government
A year with a surplus in government revenue
A year with a deficit in government revenue
A year in which tax rates are increased

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **A year that represents the financial reporting period for the government**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A fiscal year** is a one-year period that governments and businesses use for financial reporting and budgeting.
 
• The fiscal year may not align with the calendar year.
 
• Different countries and organizations may have different start and end dates for their fiscal years.
 
• It is used for accounting purposes to prepare financial statements and reports.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 This is the correct definition of a fiscal year. It is used for financial reporting and budgeting by governments and businesses.
 
 

 Option 2
 This option incorrectly defines a fiscal year as a year with a surplus in government revenue.
 
 

 Option 3
 This option incorrectly defines a fiscal year as a year with a deficit in government revenue.
 
 

 Option 4
 This option incorrectly defines a fiscal year as a year in which tax rates are increased.

questions.question: Who started the temple entry movement in 1927?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Bhimrao Ambedkar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhimrao Ambedkar** led the temple entry movement in 1927 to allow untouchables to enter Hindu temples.
 
• This movement was part of his broader efforts to fight against caste discrimination and social injustice.
 
• Ambedkar and his followers entered the Kalaram Temple in Nashik, which was a significant act of defiance against the caste system.
 
• The movement highlighted the plight of Dalits and aimed to ensure equal rights and social acceptance for them.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Mahadev Govind Ranade was a social reformer but not involved in the temple entry movement of 1927.
 
 

 Option 2
 Bhimrao Ambedkar led the temple entry movement in 1927 to fight against caste discrimination.
 
 

 Option 3
 Mahatma Gandhi supported the temple entry movement but did not start it.
 
 

 Option 4
 Annie Besant was a prominent theosophist and social reformer but not involved in this specific movement.

questions.question: In which state is Gobind Sagar (Bhakra Nangal Project) located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Himachal Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gobind Sagar** is a man-made reservoir situated in Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It is part of the **Bhakra Nangal Project**, one of India's largest and most important multipurpose river valley projects.
 
• The reservoir is formed by the **Bhakra Dam**, which is built across the Sutlej River.
 
• The Bhakra Dam is one of the highest gravity dams in the world, with a height of 225.5 meters.
 
• The Gobind Sagar reservoir provides water for irrigation, drinking, and hydroelectric power generation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Feature
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Bhakra Dam**
 A concrete gravity dam on the Sutlej River in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh.
 
 

 **Construction Period**
 The dam was constructed between 1948 and 1963.
 
 

 **Capacity**
 The Gobind Sagar reservoir has a gross storage capacity of about 9.34 billion cubic meters.
 
 

 **Hydroelectric Power**
 The project includes hydroelectric power stations with a total installed capacity of 1,325 MW.
 
 

 **Irrigation**
 Provides irrigation to the states of Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan.
 
 

 **Tourism**
 The Gobind Sagar reservoir is a popular tourist destination, known for its scenic beauty and water sports.

questions.question: The Arabian Sea is an extension of which of the following oceans?
questions.solution:

__
 
• The Arabian Sea is a region of the northern Indian Ocean.
 
• It is bounded on the west by the Arabian Peninsula and on the northeast by the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The Arabian Sea has been historically significant for maritime trade routes connecting the Middle East, Africa, and India.
 
• It is an important region for monsoon winds, which influence the climate of surrounding regions.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details

 Largest and deepest ocean, located to the east of Asia and west of the Americas.

 Encircles Antarctica and merges with the southern parts of the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans.
 
 

 Arctic Ocean
 Smallest and shallowest ocean, located in the Arctic region and surrounded by Eurasia and North America.

questions.question: Which of the following is a dimension of microfinance institutions (MFIs) in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Outreach to rural areas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Outreach to rural areas**: One of the primary goals of Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) in India is to extend financial services to underserved rural areas.
 
• **Financial Inclusion**: MFIs play a crucial role in promoting financial inclusion by providing credit to those who lack access to traditional banking services.
 
• **Poverty Alleviation**: By providing small loans to rural entrepreneurs, MFIs help in alleviating poverty and improving the standard of living.
 
• **Women Empowerment**: Many MFIs focus on lending to women, thereby empowering them economically and socially.
 
• **Sustainable Development**: MFIs contribute to sustainable development by supporting small-scale businesses and agriculture in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Microfinance**
 A set of financial services aimed at low-income individuals or those who do not have access to typical banking services.
 
 

 **MFIs**
 Organizations that provide microfinance services, including loans, savings, and insurance, primarily to the rural poor.
 
 

 **SHGs**
 Self-Help Groups are small voluntary associations of people, typically from rural areas, who come together for the purpose of solving their common problems through self-help and mutual help.
 
 

 **JLGs**
 Joint Liability Groups are informal groups of 4-10 individuals who come together for the purpose of availing bank loans either singly or through the group mechanism against mutual guarantee.
 
 

 **Financial Literacy**
 Efforts made by MFIs to educate and empower rural populations about financial products and services.

questions.question: Which vitamin is needed for a healthy immune system, low-light vision, and healthy skin?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Vitamin A**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin A** is essential for maintaining a healthy immune system.
 
• It plays a crucial role in low-light vision, allowing the eyes to function properly in dim light.
 
• Vitamin A is vital for healthy skin as it helps in the maintenance and repair of skin tissues.
 
• A deficiency in Vitamin A can lead to night blindness and an increased risk of infections.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1 (Vitamin K)
 Vitamin K is important for blood clotting and bone health.
 
 

 Option 2 (Vitamin B2)
 Vitamin B2, or riboflavin, helps in energy production and the metabolism of fats, drugs, and steroids.
 
 

 Option 3 (Vitamin B9)
 Vitamin B9, or folate, is essential for DNA synthesis and repair, and is crucial during periods of rapid growth such as pregnancy.
